title: Gravity Waves
description:
Gravity Waves is a twin stick shoot 'em up in space with realistic gravity against enemies attacking in waves which build from a gentle pace to very very hectic. 

 

Gain extra points for close-up kills and using planets, moons and the sun to slingshot you with their gravity. Wnemies drop health boosts and occaisionally extra lives.

The gravity takes a little getting used to but it provides gameplay that changes moment by moment and totally keeps you on your toes.

 

Key features:
• wave based shooter

• realistic gravity and orbits

• old school arcade action

• builds from simple encounters to fast paced, quickly changing action

• music by @remixedcat

description_short: Gravity Waves is a twin stick shoot 'em up in space with waves of enemies and realistic gravity to provide constantly changing gameplay.
